Drone Weather App Made For Us By Us!

VentoApp is the first weather app made for drone pilots by drone pilots. Measure hour by hour wind, cloud coverage, multiple locations and more with a push of a button.  

We made this so that drone pilots, multirotor pilots, drone photographers and aerial video makers could quickly identify safe flying conditions and plan best shooting times.

KEY FEATURES

Hour by Hour Weather Information - It might be too windy now, but may not in 2 hours.  Get a forecast that breaks down the day hour by hour.

Wind Strength - Drones and winds aren’t friends.  So prepare for them! Get wind measurements so you know when it’s safe to fly.

Cloud Coverage - Love clouds or hate clouds when producing aerial videos and photos. VentoApp highlights the cloud coverage percentage to indicate how much cloud coverage is in the area.

Store Multiple location - Drone run this weekend? Check the weather in multiple locations and store them as your favorites. Just drop a pin on your map and be able to see the weather for that location.

Chance of rain - Know when to hide your drone! Drones don’t like water. Go play video games.

Temperature - Know when to pack your swimsuit.

Color Coded Help - Easy to identify safe flying conditions using simple colors. Green means the weather conditions are good. Yellow means proceed with caution.

7-day Forecast - Get a feel of what the weather will be like over the week to help plan your next runs and get friends excited to fly your drone!

Weather Accuracy Disclaimer: We are using weather data provided by forecast.io.  They provide some awesome weather data, but please remember that this is a weather forecast tool!  We cannot assume responsibility for the accuracy of the data
